name: Nightfall

components.pose: She stands at the edge of her homeland as the last light goes, with drifting shadow, smoke and pale starlight gathered low in one open hand like a lantern that lights her face, looking to the camera; full figure visible.
components.effects: Drifting shadow, smoke and pale starlight light the land around her and {{MAGIC}} light glows warm against the dark.

notes: REALM SERIES: Nightfall in her darkness homeland (night); realistic, from realms/darkness-lands and backgrounds/fantasy/country/darkness.
